findings.cause: Only periodic samples and final post-cleanup sample; no guaranteed active-generation observation; sampler is cancelled before cleanup begins. Maximum is only observed periodic-sample maximum, can miss all work.
findings.suggestion: Record bounded lifecycle samples at actual active operation/generation and cleanup start/end, retain observed peaks across phases and sample eviction. Keep periodic sampling for drift; explicitly label RSS/Fd sampled maxima, not guaranteed physical peaks. Do not treat idle-only trace as active resource evidence.

positive_boundaries: Real monotonic clock used, cleanup excluded from wall observation
Attempt cap waits rest but stop_reason attempt_cap, standby/effective unknown and P14/full false; waiting not mixed acceptance
Attempts inserted before work; failure/timeout/cancel included; interrupt remains denominator
Admission calls/characters/units reserve before underlying provider IO, quota closes gate; cloud/defaultdevice denied
Unconfirmed cleanup keeps closed meter/ownership and refuses provider reuse
JSON delay/drop+stop is simulated ACK disturbance, no TLS/network/acoustic claim
cost_limit: Conditional runner-side pre-reservation under operator-reviewed worst-case microCNY/request. Not independent guarantee of provider billing/account total; billing_bound_verified false, no actual bill verified.
usefulness: Useful short/long backend protocol orchestration and failure cleanup collector after active/cleanup sampling corrected; insufficient A36/P14 actual product validation
missing_real_paths: Android business UI and AudioTrack played proof
